title: Sign in — Phone, OTP & Face ID
description: The mock sign-in journey from the signed-out home: the Sign in sheet (Figma 16360-78680) with the +965 phone field and in-frame numeric keyboard, OTP confirmation (16360-78950) with countdown resend and error state, and a simulated Face ID quick path. Everything is fake — no real authentication — the flow demos validation, OTP entry, error/success states and haptics for dev handoff. Lab menu tunes Face ID scan time, OTP verify pause and the resend timer; OTP 0000 forces the error state.

Standalone success only: Continue to Home — context {auth:'signed-in', num}

nodes.note: Home flow — 'Got an account? Sign in' presents this sheet
Logo · Welcome back! · +965 field · numeric keyboard
Proceed with mobile number, or Face ID
Short number: shake + red border + hint + error haptic
4 round cells · caret pipe · resend unlocks after countdown
Cells flash red, row shakes, clears for retry
Simulated HUD: glyph pulse → tick · tap outside cancels
Later sprint — branded card for now
Tick draw + success haptic · hands back to home

handoff.Sheet: White card sheet, radius 38 top, springs on cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); header: centred 'Sign in' Urbane 600 22/32 #0B0E12, 40pt close circle border #E5E5E5
handoff.Phone field: +965 pre-tab (Urbane 300 22/28 #0B0E12) + chevron; digits Urbane 300 22/28 #ED1C24; hairline #E5E5E5 underline, flips #ED1C24 on error with shake
handoff.Buttons: 53pt pills radius round; primary fill #ED1C24 / white Urbane 500 16; secondary white, 1px #EE2023 border, Face ID glyph (red→orange gradient) + #0B0E12 label
handoff.OTP cells: 44pt circles, 2px border — empty #E5E5E5 with blinking pipe, filled #454545, error #ED1C24; verify pulse scale 1.07
handoff.OTP copy: Chat bubble 30pt #ED1C24 · 'OTP SENT' Urbane 600 30/40 #ED1C24 · sent-to line Proxima 400 18/28 #0B0E12 · resend Proxima 15/22, link unlocks after countdown
handoff.Keyboard: In-frame iOS numeric board: #E6E9ED, top radius 27, keys 50pt white radius 8.5, SF 23pt; delete borderless — native uses the real keyboard, this is the design twin
handoff.Face ID: Simulated HUD 152pt, radius 34, rgba(28,28,30,.82) + blur; white glyph pulses through scan, circle+tick draw on success — native uses LocalAuthentication
handoff.Haptics: Key tap light(8) · error [24,60,24] · success [10,40,16] — via native bridge {t:'haptic'} first, navigator.vibrate fallback
handoff.Mock rules: Any 8-digit number proceeds · OTP 0000 forces the error state · Face ID always matches

swift.note: Present as a .sheet over the signed-out home; one state enum drives push-style transitions inside the card.
Native text field with .keyboardType(.numberPad); the web prototype's in-frame keyboard is only the design twin of the system board.
Hidden TextField carries focus; cells render its value. 0000 demos the error path in the mock.
The web HUD is a simulation; native calls LocalAuthentication — same success beat and haptic either way.
